decisions.reason: As the flagship home-page product, it likely meets or exceeds aspirations and remains central to the firm's innovative messaging direction.
Its dedicated page and fit with document workflow innovation suggest performance above aspiration, so it is retained.
Email-to-fax conversion still serves fax-reliant German customers, and organisational slack allows carrying it while results remain stable.
This narrow fax optimization feature has likely fallen below aspirations given the firm's shift toward cloud multichannel messaging, so problemistic search reallocates its resources.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses growing security needs and likely meets aspirations, so it is kept.
Multi-engine virus scanning overlaps with the broader security offer and likely falls short of aspirations as a standalone product, leading to reallocation.
